proposal.root_cause: Commit 62e722b ("adjust resource limits") lowered api memory request/limit from 96Mi/128Mi to 24Mi/32Mi, so the container is OOMKilled (exit 137) and crash-loops.
proposal.rationale: Pod lastState is OOMKilled with a 32Mi limit; the git diff of 62e722b shows the previous good values were 96Mi request and 128Mi limit. This patch restores them.
proposal.verify: The api pod runs without OOMKilled restarts, becomes Ready, and the Deployment has a 128Mi memory limit.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: python:3.12-alpine
          command: ["python", "/app/app.py"]
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          env:
            - name: APP_VERSION
              value: "1.0.0"
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: api-config
          volumeMounts:
            - name: code
              mountPath: /app
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            periodSeconds: 5
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8000
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 24Mi
              cpu: 50m
            limits:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 500m
      volumes:
        - name: code
          configMap:
            name: api-code
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: api
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/api.yaml
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000
